semiconductor_relevance: High — TES Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of semiconductor equipment, specifically focusing on thin film deposition and display technologies.
summary: TES Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of semiconductor equipment, particularly thin film deposition systems and FPD/LCD equipment. The company also develops proprietary software to enhance the performance of its equipment, positioning itself for future advancements in the 300 mm equipment development market.

regional_presence.Korea: TES has significantly contributed to Korea's recognition as a powerhouse in the semiconductor and display industries.
